message.content: {"has_issues": true, "issues": ["The memo treats the same fact\u2014multiple amendments since 2022\u2014as both a strength (evidence of borrower compliance and lender engagement) and a risk (potential sign of covenant pressure/operational complexity).", "It characterizes the security package as already comprehensive (including deposit account controls and IP security) while also listing those exact items as post-closing deliverables due within 45\u201365 days, implying they are not yet in place."]}
